title: myriopteris aurea
intro: Myriopteris aurea, commonly known as the Golden Rattlesnake Fern, is a species of fern in the family Adiantaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and it is known to exhibit various health benefits, such as lowering blood pressure and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Myriopteris aurea include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions like anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
